originalTitle: Chris Wood warns AI capex binge may burn billions as markets turn against Big Tech spending
simplifiedContent: Investor Chris Wood is warning that big tech companies may waste billions of dollars on artificial intelligence (AI) investments. He thinks these companies, known as "hyperscalers", are spending too much money on AI and it may not pay off. Wood believes that the AI industry might be more like the airline industry, where many companies compete and not just one or two dominate. This matters because if Wood is right, it could affect the stock prices of these big tech companies. Wood has been saying this for a while, and it's a negative view on the tech industry's spending habits.

originalTitle: Divi's Labs Q1 Results: Net profit rises 66% YoY to Rs 902 crore, revenue up 28%
simplifiedContent: Divi's Labs, a company, just released its financial results for the first quarter of the year. The company's profit increased by 66% compared to the same time last year, reaching Rs 902 crore. The company also made more money from its main business activities, with revenue increasing by 28% to Rs 3,080 crore. This matters because it shows that the company is performing well and making more money than it did last year. The company's expenses also rose, but not as quickly as its revenue, which is a good sign for the company's financial health.

originalTitle: Sunil Singhania's Abakkus portfolio: 5 stocks rally up to 105% in CY26; 2 new buys added in Q1
simplifiedContent: Sunil Singhania, a well-known investor, has a portfolio called Abakkus. In the first part of 2026, some of the stocks in this portfolio did very well, with a few of them increasing in value by as much as 105%. This means that the value of these stocks more than doubled. The portfolio also added two new stocks in the first quarter of the year. This news matters because it shows how Sunil Singhania's investment choices are performing and what new stocks he is interested in.

originalTitle: Zee share price to be in focus on Monday after Sebi bars Subhash Chandra, Punit Goenka for one year
simplifiedContent: On Monday, people will be paying close attention to the stock price of Zee (ZEEL) because of a big decision made by SEBI, a group that regulates the stock market. SEBI has banned two important people, Subhash Chandra and Punit Goenka, from participating in the stock market for one year. This decision was made after SEBI looked into some issues with loans taken by companies related to the Essel Group, and they found that some important documents were missing. The stock price of Zee actually went up by 2.85% recently, but overall it's still down compared to where it was a year ago and five years ago. This news matters because it could affect the stock price of Zee and influence how investors decide to buy or sell the stock.

originalTitle: Expert view: AI will be useful in trading, but it can't replace judgment, says Shai Coelho of Vtrender
simplifiedContent: A trading expert named Shai Coelho from Vtrender thinks that artificial intelligence (AI) can be helpful in buying and selling stocks, but it's not enough on its own. According to Coelho, human judgment is still necessary to make good trading decisions. This means that while AI can make some parts of trading easier, it can't replace the thinking and decision-making that a human can do. Coelho believes that understanding the market, including how people behave and the overall structure, is key to making good choices. This matters because it suggests that investors should use AI as a tool, but not rely solely on it to make trading decisions.

originalTitle: Stocks to buy under  ₹200: Mehul Kothari of Anand Rathi recommends three shares to buy or sell
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a good day, with two important indexes, Sensex and Nifty 50, reaching their highest points in three weeks. This happened because foreign investors put more money into the market and oil prices went down. A financial expert named Mehul Kothari thinks it's a good idea to buy shares of three companies: Vodafone Idea, YES Bank, and Suzlon Energy, because their prices are currently under ₹200. This might be a good opportunity for investors looking to buy stocks at a relatively low price. By recommending these stocks, Mehul Kothari is suggesting that they could be a good investment.
